title: Sliding recurrence check
statement: Let $X$ be a set, let $G\colon X^3\to X$, let $e\in X$, and let $u,v$ be finite lists in $X$ with $|u|=|v|$. The Boolean flag obtained by starting from $(e,e,e,\mathrm{true})$, processing the pairs in the zip of $u$ and $v$ followed by two copies of $(e,e)$, and at each step updating the triple and retaining the flag exactly when the previous middle entry equals $G$ applied to the previous triple, is true if and only if, for every integer $i<|u|+2$, the entry at position $i$ of the list $e::v$ equals $G$ applied to the entries at positions $i,i+1,i+2$ of $e::e::u$, where any out-of-range entry is interpreted as $e$.
